profile.summary: A cabinet-level agency of the State of California government. It oversees departments, conservancies and commissions that protect and manage the state's natural landscapes, cultural sites, lands and waterways. It also administers grant programs, including the Youth Community Access Grant Program, which funds youth access to natural and cultural resources.
